canonical_project: Datec Sovereign AI Data Centre solutions roadshow - Lae
notes: NBC PNG (2026-06-13) reports Datec's AI-Driven Sovereign Data Centre Roadshow held at Hotel Morobe, Lae, promoting locally hosted sovereign data services; Datec (40 years in PNG, 8 branches) works in partnership with Telikom PNG and CloudSigma. Promotional roadshow with no physical Lae data-centre facility or capacity confirmed; recorded as announced lead per methodology (roadshow/pre-launch = announced/planned).
